skills.name: Lunatic - Risktaker+
lines: Activate Lunatic with Status Risktaker on user (5 turns).
** +70% damage and healing (Multiplier: x1.7)
** Guaranteed physical and magical critical (continuous)
** Damage on self 20% of current HP before any attack move.
*** 20% self-damage only triggers once on Copy
*** No self-damage on EoT moves, but Critical rate & x1.7 damage boost applies
*** Counterattack moves doesn't get this effect.
*** 20% self-damage does not additionally apply to innate self-damage part of moves
*** 20% self-damage is rounded down for HP not divisible by 5. i.e. new HP its slightly more than 80%
* Replaces the basic attack until used (1 activation)
* When in an Elemental/Attack Type Zone:
** Once per battle: awaken Another Zone (2 turns)
** Once per battle: When in Biting Shade Stance: awaken Radical Zone (4 turns)

abilities.name: Another Zone
lines: Awakens any Elemental Type Zones or a Damage Type Attack Zones or some Hybrid Zones:
* Applicable Hybrid Zones are Double Strike Stance Attack Zones, & Moonlight Stance
* Doubles damage multiplicators for Zones:
** to +60% for Attack Zones and Thunder, Crystal, Shade (other elements) Type Zones
** to +100% for Fire, Water, Wind, Earth and Shade Type Zones
** Doubles "damage on weakness/resist" effects for Crystal/Shade Type Zone respectively
* Zone cannot be overwritten by other zones during the duration and duration cannot be extended by attempting to reactivate Another Zone
* Zone can still be removed/broken by skills that remove zones
* After duration ends, zone is removed
* Support Effects can be used at the same time as Another Zone
* Via active skills, can be activated only once per character
** When there is no appropriate zone or the zone is already awakened, using a skill that can awaken Zone will not consume awakening ability
** Non-active skill sources may activate it more than once per battle if explicitly stated

** to +100% for Fire, Water, Wind, Earth and Shade Type Zones

* Zone cannot be overwritten by other zones during the duration and duration cannot be extended by attempting to activate Another Zone or reactivate R. Zone
* Zone can still be removed/broken by skills that remove zones
* After duration ends, zone is removed
* Support Effects can be used at the same time as R. Zone
* Sonority effects will be strengthen in R. Zone
* Via active skills, can be activated only once per character
** When there is no appropriate zone or the zone is already awakened, using a skill that can "awaken" R. Zone will not consume awakening ability
** Non-active skill sources may activate it more than once per battle if explicitly stated

stellar_skills.name: Andante
lines: Shade type slash attack on random enemies x3 (XXL, increase skill damage 10 times 10x of the standard skill multiplier of 250% )

** When at 3+ Stacks: Shade type slash attack on random enemies x3 (XXL, increase skill damage 10 times 10x of the standard skill multiplier of 250% )
** When at 6+ Stacks: Shade type slash attack on random enemies x5 (XXL, increase skill damage 10 times 10x of the standard skill multiplier of 250% )
** When at 10 Stacks: Shade type slash attack on all enemies (XXL, increase skill damage 20 times 20x of the standard skill multiplier of 210% )
* In Stellar Burst: Before attack apply Singular Focus on user (5 turns) and does not consume Resonance [Sacrifice]
** When at 10 Stacks: Inflict Expose (Shade) on all enemies (Current turn only)
*** Exposed: Inflict Weakness to enemy (does not override null or absorb)
